stories.headline: Grok 4.6 can now run agents that keep going for hours
stories.blurb: xAI's latest model is built for agents that tackle multi-step tasks over long sessions—think coding projects that span hours, not minutes. It also handles more complex visual and interactive work than Grok 4.5.
stories.why_it_matters: Agents that don't quit after one API call get closer to actually finishing real work.

stories.headline: IBM will train 30,000 consultants to deploy OpenAI in client companies
stories.blurb: IBM is certifying tens of thousands of its consultants on OpenAI's models and tools, then sending them into Fortune 500s to build custom AI systems. It's the biggest consulting play yet to turn ChatGPT's tech into something companies can actually run inside their own operations.
stories.why_it_matters: Enterprise AI is shifting from proof-of-concept to mass deployment through consulting armies.
stories.original_headline: IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster enterprise AI push

stories.headline: Google Sheets now lets you turn spreadsheets into visual reports
stories.blurb: Google just added a canvas mode to Sheets that lets you build dashboards, timelines, and formatted reports directly on top of your spreadsheet data — no need to copy-paste into Slides or Docs. You can drop in charts, tables, images, and text blocks that pull live data from your tabs.
stories.why_it_matters: Spreadsheets can finally be the presentation, not just the data behind it.
stories.original_headline: Bring your spreadsheet data to life with Sheets canvas

stories.headline: Cursor agents now boot 3x faster by pre-installing dependencies
stories.blurb: Cloud agents in Cursor now start with repos already cloned and dependencies installed. Instead of waiting for npm/pip/yarn to run before every session, the build step happens once — then agents spin up in seconds with everything ready.
stories.why_it_matters: Less waiting for agent sessions means more flow state during development.
stories.original_headline: Cloud Agents Start 3x Faster with Builds
